title: Alchemy Deployment Structure Corrections Tasks
principles: The existing one-resource DocsWebsite composition and Alchemy-owned Vite build are preserved.
Workflow YAML owns authority, permissions, concurrency and sequencing; typed Effect code owns data meaning and evidence encoding.
Cloudflare credentials are available only to exact provider steps and are never evidence.
Local, GitHub, provider, hosted and public claims remain separate.
No implementation starts until the SPEC is accepted and an active execution plan is created.

tasks.implementationPrompt: Start only after SPEC acceptance and creation of the active plan. Set the shared Production group to cancel-in-progress false for every operation. Move the Cloudflare token to the minimum named provider steps; do not pass it to checkout, install, build, repository validation, evidence upload or unrelated actions. Keep the existing Preview/teardown exact-stage non-cancellable group unchanged. State plainly that GitHub locks do not lock manual CLI work, that normal concurrent manual mutation is unsupported, and that interruption during bootstrap or mutation requires state/provider readback before retry. Do not add an external lease.

tasks.goal: Close ALC-AUD-003 and ALC-AUD-R001 with one narrow command that tells the truth about beta.64 bootstrap and removes repeated evidence shell.
outputs: one closed-mode Effect command for shared identity, plan projection, provider JSON decoding and receipt/output encoding

tasks.implementationPrompt: Reuse the owning stage, plan-projection and provider inventory Schemas. Add one narrow command under tools/docs-deployment with named modes only; do not add arbitrary command execution, a generic provider wrapper or helpers/common/utils. YAML must still choose the environment and operation, hold permissions and locks, run Alchemy and provider CLIs, and stop on failure. The typed command may calculate identities, decode named bounded files and encode sanitised outputs. Treat bootstrap as an authorised mutation-capable step whose allowed effects include credential refresh, a short-lived edge-preview secret read and state-store create or upgrade. Never label it read-only or cache-only, and never record credentials or temporary secret-bearing URLs.

tasks.title: Make hosted proof a strict Effect boundary
tasks.goal: Close ALC-AUD-004 by rejecting malformed hosted-proof input before browser startup and guaranteeing browser cleanup.
outputs: Effect Config definitions and owning Schemas for every hosted-proof environment input
whole-string bounded numeric decoding with no permissive parseInt
safe tagged configuration, execution and evidence errors
a focused Playwright host adapter wrapped by Effect.tryPromise
scoped browser acquire/release across success, failure and interruption
malformed-input, unsafe-path, secret-negative and cleanup tests
updated app and strict-boundary owner text
docs/documentation-audit/alchemy-deployment-structure/ADS-003-validation.json
tasks.implementationPrompt: Decode every environment value once through Effect Config and owning Schemas before Playwright starts. Require complete numeric strings and bounded positive values; reject values such as 12x, zero where forbidden, invalid URLs, invalid digests, invalid stages and unsafe output paths. Keep the Playwright Promise API in one focused host adapter and adapt it immediately with Effect.tryPromise. Use Scope and acquireRelease so the browser closes on success, failure and interruption. Use one BunRuntime.runMain application boundary. Safe errors may name a key or operation but must not echo values, URLs with secrets, raw environment content or local absolute paths. Do not create a generic browser or process framework.
mandatoryVerification: Focused tests for missing, empty, malformed, prefix-numeric, out-of-range, invalid URL, invalid digest, invalid stage and unsafe path inputs
Focused tests proving the browser is not acquired for invalid Config
Focused tests proving browser close on success, failure and interruption
Safe tagged error and secret-negative rendering tests

browserVerification: Run the provider-free browser-host adapter tests locally.
Run the existing trusted Preview or Production hosted journey only if the exact workflow operation is separately authorised; retain its normal receipt and do not broaden the claim.
qualityAudits: Review every process.env, Number.parseInt, Promise and browser lifecycle use in the hosted-proof surface.
